en: season the sauce in hot oil

does: Pours a blended tomato or chilli sauce into very hot fat and fries it, stirring, until it darkens, thickens and loses its raw taste.
how: Heat a little fat in a wide pan until it shimmers.
Pour in the sauce all at once and stand back, as it spits hard.
Stir as it bubbles until it turns a shade darker, thickens and the fat starts to show at the edges.

cues.text: A loud sizzle as the sauce hits the fat.
The sauce darkens and thickens, and the colour deepens from bright to brick red or olive green.
The raw smell of onion and garlic turns sweet and cooked.

mistakes.mistake: Adding the sauce to fat that is not hot enough, so it only warms through.
mistakes.fix: Wait until the fat shimmers; the sauce should sizzle hard.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving it unstirred, so it catches and burns on the bottom.
mistakes.fix: Stir and scrape the bottom as it bubbles.

comes_after.why: The sauce is blended before it is fried.
